note: Eurostat tables whose monthly or quarterly values are flows over the period, so a whole year is their sum. Units alone cannot tell (THS_T is a flow in trade and a stock in oil stocks), so a table counts only by its registered id prefix. Stocks (nrg_stk_) are not listed.

prefixes.what: energy supply flows: production, imports, exports, deliveries (6 monthly-only tables, 10-28; nrg_cb_cosm also holds A and stays annual)
